english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person with poor judgment or little intelligence.

exampleSentences.english: You're a fool to believe that.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 so4 zai2 gam2 dou1 seon3

english.note: For a naive or foolish person, this is the all-purpose colloquial choice.

exampleSentences.english: You’re so easily fooled; you’re really a sap.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你咁容易畀人呃，真係個傻仔。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gam3 jung4 ji6 bei2 jan4 ngaak1 zan1 hai6 go3 so4 zai2

english.note: Use this for an unintentionally ridiculous or foolish person rather than specifically a stage performer.

exampleSentences.english: You’re such a buffoon to believe what he said.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你真係個傻仔，咁都信佢講。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 go3 so4 zai2 gam3 dou1 seon3 keoi5 gong2

english.note: Use this for a person who behaves foolishly or acts silly, especially in casual speech.

exampleSentences.english: You're such a clown, you actually believed that.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 go3 so4 zai2 gam2 dou1 seon3
